subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add user OAuth credentials for outbound reactions, native media uploads, reaction typing, and user-auth DM lookup, and what secret/scoped-token model is acceptable?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementing it adds security-sensitive OAuth credential storage and new config behavior that repository policy says needs maintainer product/security judgment before repair work.

options.title: Sponsor strict plugin-owned OAuth
options.body: Add a Google Chat user OAuth credential model with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped client routing, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Ship only fallback mitigations
options.body: Review the media-fallback PRs for app-auth message loss and leave native user-auth reactions/uploads/proactive DMs unscheduled for now.

options.title: Decline bundled user OAuth
options.body: Close the direction only if maintainers decide user OAuth should live outside the bundled plugin or behind a future external plugin/API discussion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor strict plugin-owned OAuth
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat user OAuth credential model with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped client routing, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the prior product/security-oriented review on this issue and is the best visible routing candidate from the discussion history.
